issues.message: cpml_layers=16 exceeds the z-axis grid extent (10 cells: ceil(20mm/2.998mm)+1 interior nodes + 0/2 absorber cells, from z=Boundary(lo='pec', hi='cpml')). The absorber you asked for is unaffected — the layer budget is clamped to the axis for the CPML scratch buffers only, and the clamped region carries no active absorber layers (issue #647). It does mean the layer count was sized for a coarser mesh or a larger domain than this one; set that face's lo_thickness/hi_thickness explicitly if you meant a thinner absorber.

face z_hi is declared cpml with 2 layers; nearest measured depths: 4 layers (no interpolation). CPML reference reflections measured at 1 mm cells with the shipped CFS alpha (#1272, #1346): 4 layers: -20 dB at 2 GHz, -23 dB at 10 GHz, -17 dB at 30 GHz, -6 dB below 1 GHz. These reference values do not predict reflection on a different mesh or for UPML. Use at least 8 absorbing layers; 16 layers is the default recommendation.
